name: Beyond the Stars
source:
You are the captain of a survey vessel sent out to investigate potential colony worlds, with your two junior officers, Aiko and Xin.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=50&t=19935]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
你是一艘调查船的船长，和你的两名下级军官Aiko和Xin一起被派去调查潜在的殖民地世界。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=50&t=19935]引理软论坛[/url]]
